resources.string: Shows a dictation bubble when you focus a text field, and types the dictated text into that field. It reads the focused field and nearby screen text only while a dictation is in progress.
The dictation service is on. Focus a text field in any app and tap the bubble.

To turn it on: Accessibility → openWisprFlow dictation → Use openWisprFlow dictation.\n\nIf the switch is greyed out (\"restricted setting\"), go to App info → ⋮ menu → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Build step 1: tapping the bubble types a fixed test phrase.
